title: Apple Watch Pre-Order Discounts Expand With Up to $20 In Savings
content:
Apple began pre-orders for its new Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4 last week, and today Amazon has introduced a few more early discounts on these models.

Note: MacRumors is an affiliate partner with some of these vendors. When you click a link and make a purchase, we may receive a small payment, which helps us keep the site running.

Apple Watch Series 12


Apple Watch Series 12 models are up for pre-order on Amazon today, starting at $389.99 for 42mm GPS devices ($9 off) and $439.99 for 46mm GPS devices ($9 off). These will launch on September 18, and as of writing only the Black Aluminum Case with Black Sport Band 42mm GPS model is on sale.

$9 OFF
Apple Watch Series 12 (42mm GPS) for $389.99

$9 OFF
Apple Watch Series 12 (46mm GPS) for $439.99


If you're interested in the cellular models of the Apple Watch Series 12, the 42mm Cellular Series 12 is available for pre-order at $489.99, down from $499.00. This is for the new Dark Bronze Aluminum Case with Olive Sport Band.

$9 OFF
Apple Watch Series 12 (42mm Cell) for $489.99

$9 OFF
Apple Watch Series 12 (46mm Cell) for $539.99


You can also pre-order the new Titanium Apple Watch Series 12 models starting at $679.00 ($20 off), and the Ceramic model is available for $929.00 ($20 off).

Apple Watch Ultra 4


The Apple Watch Ultra 4 is available for pre-order on Amazon for $779.99 in the Natural Titanium Case with Translucent Gray Ocean Band. This device will launch on September 18, alongside the Series 12 and AirPods 5.

$19 OFF
Apple Watch Ultra 4 for $779.99
